presets.name: Basic
presets.description: The smallest strongly recommended emergency library.

presets.name: Suggested
presets.description: Recommended for most installations; includes Basic plus community response, weather, livestock, military survival, home canning, current first-aid doctrine, and compact botanical safety guidance.

presets.name: Comprehensive

packages.title: Are You Ready? An In-Depth Guide to Citizen Preparedness

packages.license: Public domain — CDC STACKS

packages.title: Prepare Your Health: Practical Skills
packages.description: CDC emergency practical-skills fact sheet, including immediate response and first-aid readiness.

packages.license: Public domain — CDC STACKS

packages.title: Best Practices Guide: Fundamentals of a Workplace First-Aid Program
packages.description: OSHA guidance on first-aid readiness, supplies, training, CPR, and AED programs.
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; public domain under 17 U.S.C. § 105

packages.title: Community Emergency Response Team Basic Training
packages.description: FEMA participant material for disaster preparedness, fire safety, medical operations, search and rescue, organization, and communications.
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; public domain under 17 U.S.C. § 105 except identified third-party material

packages.title: Weather Spotter's Field Guide
packages.description: National Weather Service guide to recognizing and safely reporting severe weather.
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; public domain under 17 U.S.C. § 105 except identified third-party material

packages.title: Do You Have a Plan for Your Livestock Should Disaster Strike?
packages.description: USDA preparedness checklist for livestock evacuation, supplies, identification, sheltering, and emergency contacts.
packages.organization: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; public domain under 17 U.S.C. § 105 except identified third-party material

packages.title: Casualty Response, Tactical Combat Casualty Care, and First Aid
packages.description: Current U.S. Army first-aid doctrine for nonmedical responders; complements, but does not replace, certified training or professional care.
packages.organization: United States Department of the Army
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; public domain under 17 U.S.C. § 105 except identified third-party material

packages.title: Emergency Water Supply Planning Guide
packages.description: CDC and EPA process for auditing water use, evaluating alternatives, and exercising an emergency water supply plan.
packages.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
packages.license: Public domain — CDC STACKS

packages.title: Botanical Dietary Supplements: Background Information
packages.description: Compact NIH safety primer covering teas, decoctions, tinctures and extracts; evidence quality; concentration and toxicity risks; quality control; and the limits of supplement regulation.
packages.organization: National Institutes of Health, Office of Dietary Supplements
packages.original_source: Botanical Dietary Supplements Fact Sheet for Consumers
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; public domain under 17 U.S.C. § 105 except identified third-party material
packages.evidence_scope: Modern general safety and evidence-evaluation guidance; not a plant-identification manual or treatment recommendation.

safety_metadata.medication_interactions: General interaction warning; consult the source and a qualified clinician or pharmacist.
safety_metadata.pregnancy_breastfeeding: No plant-specific guidance; do not infer safety.
safety_metadata.children: No plant-specific guidance; do not infer safety.
safety_metadata.identification_hazards: Not covered; use an authoritative regional identification source.

packages.title: A Guide to Medicinal Plants of Appalachia
packages.description: Illustrated 1969 USDA reference describing 126 Appalachian plants. Preserved for identification and historical research; USDA explicitly warns that it is not a self-medication recommendation and that some plants are extremely poisonous.
packages.organization: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Forest Service
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; public domain under 17 U.S.C. § 105 except identified third-party material
packages.evidence_scope: Historical ethnobotanical and identification reference; uses are not current clinical guidance.

safety_metadata.known_toxicity: The publisher warns that some described crude drugs can be extremely poisonous.
safety_metadata.medication_interactions: Not systematically covered; do not infer absence of interactions.
safety_metadata.pregnancy_breastfeeding: Not systematically covered; do not infer safety.
safety_metadata.children: Not systematically covered; do not infer safety.
safety_metadata.identification_hazards: Identification is safety-critical; regional applicability and dangerous look-alikes must be checked independently.

packages.title: Herbal Simples Approved for Modern Uses of Cure
packages.description: Late-19th-century herbal reference retained as historical source testimony. Its medical claims may be obsolete, unsupported, or unsafe and must not be presented as modern clinical guidance.
packages.author: William Thomas Fernie
packages.license: Public domain in the USA — Project Gutenberg License
packages.evidence_scope: Historical claims only; not evidence of effectiveness and not current medical advice.

safety_metadata.known_toxicity: Not consistently documented to modern standards.
safety_metadata.medication_interactions: Predates modern interaction evidence; do not infer absence of interactions.
safety_metadata.pregnancy_breastfeeding: Historical text is not a reliable safety source.
safety_metadata.children: Historical text is not a reliable safety source.
safety_metadata.identification_hazards: Names and classifications may be dated; verify scientific identity with a current regional authority.

packages.title: Survival, Evasion, and Recovery
packages.description: Multiservice pocket reference covering survival priorities, shelter, navigation, signaling, recovery, medical needs, water, food, firecraft, and environmental hazards. Military context and its 1999 publication date should be considered when applying it to civilian situations.
packages.organization: U.S. Army; U.S. Marine Corps; U.S. Navy; U.S. Air Force
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; Distribution Statement A — approved for public release, distribution unlimited

packages.title: Complete Guide to Home Canning — Guide 1: Principles of Home Canning
packages.description: USDA principles for safe home canning, including acidity, processing methods, altitude adjustments, pressure and boiling-water canners, seals, storage, and spoilage hazards.
packages.original_source: USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning, 2015 revision, Guide 1
packages.license: U.S. federal government publication; public domain under 17 U.S.C. § 105 except identified third-party material

packages.title: Risk Management
packages.description: Army framework for identifying hazards, assessing risk, developing controls, making risk decisions, and supervising and evaluating those controls.
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; approved for public release, distribution unlimited

packages.title: Base Camps
packages.description: Army and Marine Corps reference covering camp planning, construction, infrastructure, operations, maintenance, utilities, sanitation, communications, safety, and closure.
packages.organization: Department of the Army; United States Marine Corps
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; approved for public release, distribution unlimited

packages.title: Ground Equipment Battle Damage Assessment, Repair, and Recovery
packages.description: Current Army and Marine Corps reference for equipment recovery, nonstandard repairs, rigging, winching, anchors, mechanical advantage, and operator safety. Many procedures require trained personnel and rated equipment.
packages.organization: Department of the Army; United States Marine Corps
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; approved for public release, distribution unlimited

packages.title: Marine Corps Water Survival
packages.description: Marine Corps techniques and training standards for flotation, water entry, rescues, water obstacles, survival equipment, and aquatic emergencies. Training-intensive procedures should not be attempted beyond the user's ability.
packages.license: U.S. federal government work; Distribution Statement A — approved for public release, distribution unlimited

packages.title: Finding Your Way with Map and Compass
packages.description: A concise USGS guide to topographic-map scale, distance, direction, bearings, magnetic declination, and compass use.
packages.author: Water Resources Division, U.S. Geological Survey
packages.license: Public domain — USGS Sources/Usage; U.S. federal government work

packages.title: How to Make a Vegetable Garden
packages.description: A detailed 1905 manual covering garden planning, soil preparation, sowing, transplanting, cultivation, pests, and individual vegetables. Historical methods and pesticide advice must be checked against current extension guidance.
packages.author: Edith Loring Fullerton
packages.original_source: Doubleday, Page & Company, New York; first published April 1905
packages.license: Public domain in the United States — published in 1905

packages.title: Farm Mechanics
packages.description: An illustrated 1918 reference on hand tools, shop work, machinery, farm waterworks, and equipment care and repair. Historical electrical, fuel, and machinery procedures may not meet current safety standards.
packages.author: Herbert A. Shearer
packages.license: Public domain in the United States — published in 1918

packages.title: Handy Farm Devices and How to Make Them
packages.description: A 1912 collection of illustrated, small-scale farm and household devices, workshop aids, storage ideas, and practical construction projects. Designs require modern structural, electrical, fire, and food-safety review.
packages.author: Rolfe Cobleigh
packages.original_source: Orange Judd Company, New York, 1912 edition
packages.license: Public domain in the United States — published in 1912

packages.title: Training Manual in Topography, Map Reading and Reconnaissance
packages.description: A 1917 U.S. Army Corps of Engineers manual covering contours, scales, coordinates, compass work, field sketching, and reconnaissance. Coordinate systems and military procedures are historical.
packages.author: George Redfield Spalding; U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
packages.license: Public domain in the United States — U.S. federal government publication and published in 1917
